mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate below 4.0% signals strong labor demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not positive despite UNRATE remaining below 4.0% for 30 consecutive days.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS remaining above 4.0% for 30 consecutive days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and sustained low unemployment both indicate accommodative monetary policy, synergistically boosting investor confidence and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not positive despite both FEDFUNDS <2.0% and UNRATE <4.0% for 30 consecutive days.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate amplifies market optimism, leading to significantly higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not positive when FEDFUNDS <2.0% in the late-cycle expansion regime for 30 consecutive days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP demand (GDPC1) above its 4-month high signals robust economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not positive despite GDPC1 remaining above its 4-month high for 30 consecutive days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained weakness in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 95 indicates reduced supply-side capacity, leading to upward pressure on prices and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not positive when INDPRO remains below 95 for 60 consecutive days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous surge in job growth (PAYEMS) and rising GDP demand (GDPC1) both signal robust economic momentum, which amplifies market confidence and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are not positive despite both PAYEMS > previous high and GDPC1 > previous high for 30 consecutive instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.0% signals policy accommodation, which accelerates market recovery and produces significantly higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not positive when FEDFUNDS <2.0% in the post-shock recovery regime for 30 consecutive days.
